Package com.anhtester.driver

Class DriverEventListener

java.lang.Object
com.anhtester.driver.DriverEventListener
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.openqa.selenium.support.events.WebDriverListener
public class DriverEventListener extends Object implements org.openqa.selenium.support.events.WebDriverListener
Log every important WebDriver action automatically (navigation, click, typing, alert, quit, errors) with its duration. Attached in TargetFactory through EventFiringDecorator.

Events are logged at DEBUG level: they go into the per-test log file (exports/logs/tests) without flooding the console. A slow action (more than SLOW_ACTION_MS ms) is logged at WARN.

A listener must never throw, otherwise it would break the test: every method is protected.
